# Hardrock Sand And Gravel

> Hardrock Sand And Gravel is a veteran and woman owned sand and gravel supplier based in Sherman, TX, in business since 2016, delivering pea gravel, 57 and 67 rock, road base, decomposed granite, pink granite, mason sand, river rock, rip rap and fill dirt to Grayson, Collin, Denton, Fannin and Cooke counties, Texas, and handling driveways, house pads, ponds and land clearing. Delivery only, no customer pickup.

## About
Hardrock Sand And Gravel is a veteran and woman owned sand and gravel supplier based in Sherman, TX, in business since 2016, delivering to Grayson, Collin, Denton, Fannin and Cooke counties. Delivery only, no customer pickup. Services include delivery, pea gravel, decomposed granite, pink granite, 57 rock and 67 rock. Owner: Dean Jones. The business is a Veteran & Woman Owned Business and a HUB (Historically Underutilized Business), and carries $1M general liability and umbrella insurance. Material is priced by the ton and by the yard; a full load is 20 yards or 20 tons; the delivered price is quoted by phone from the material, the amount and the delivery address. Same-day delivery is sometimes possible. Driveways, house pads, ponds and land clearing always get a site visit (elevation and soil type) before a quote. Contractor accounts are available on Net 30 terms. Call 903-420-0330 for availability and pricing.

## Gravel Driveways in Sherman, TX
URL: https://hardrock-sand-and-gravel.pageone.cloud/services/driveways/
Title: Gravel Driveways in Sherman, TX | Hardrock Sand And Gravel
Description: Gravel driveways built in layers of road base and crushed top rock for homes, farms and rural lots in Sherman and Grayson County. Call HARDROCK at 903-420-0330.

Hardrock Sand And Gravel builds gravel driveways for homes, farms and rural lots in Sherman, Denison and Grayson County, and delivers the road base and top rock to owners who would rather lay their own. A drive built in compacted layers holds up on Blackland Prairie clay far better than rock dumped on bare dirt.

Gravel driveways rut on Grayson County clay because the clay underneath turns soft when wet and the rock gets pushed down into it. Much of the county sits on Blackland Prairie soil that swells after rain and cracks open in summer, so a drive with no firm base keeps losing rock into the mud.

A gravel driveway that lasts is built in layers: a shaped, crowned subgrade, 4 to 6 inches of compacted road base, then 2 to 3 inches of top rock. On soft clay, many builders roll out geotextile fabric between the dirt and the base so the base cannot work down into the mud.

Questions answered on this page:
- How much gravel do I need for my driveway? Work out each layer on its own: length times width times depth in feet, divided by 27. A shorter drive, 100 feet long and 10 feet wide, takes about 18.5 cubic yards of road base at 6 inches and about 9.3 cubic yards of top rock at 3 inches. Hardrock Sand And Gravel will check the figures with you at 903-420-0330.
- Which type of gravel should I use for a driveway? A common build is compacted road base underneath with an angular crushed rock such as 57 or 67 on top. Leave pea gravel and river rock off the drive, because round stones roll under tires. Tell Hardrock Sand And Gravel what will use the drive, from a family car to a loaded stock trailer, and HARDROCK will suggest a mix.
- Do you sell driveway gravel by the ton or the cubic yard? Both. Hardrock Sand And Gravel prices driveway base and rock by the ton and by the yard, and a full load is 20 yards or 20 tons. Bring your cubic-yard figures for the base and the top rock to the call for a delivered-material price. A finished drive is always quoted after a site visit to check the elevation and the soil type.

## House Pads for New Slabs in Sherman, TX
URL: https://hardrock-sand-and-gravel.pageone.cloud/services/house-pads/
Title: House Pads in Sherman, TX | Hardrock Sand And Gravel
Description: House pads raised and leveled with fill and base for new slabs in Sherman, Denison and Grayson County. Call HARDROCK at 903-420-0330 with your pad spec.

Hardrock Sand And Gravel builds house pads across Sherman, Denison and Grayson County, raising and leveling the building site with fill and base material so the new slab goes down on flat, firm ground. Send the builder's or engineer's pad spec, and HARDROCK prices the material and the work by phone.

A new slab needs a raised house pad in Grayson County because the native clay moves. Blackland Prairie soils such as Houston Black clay swell when wet and shrink as they dry, and a pad of controlled fill lifts the slab clear of standing water and gives it even, compacted support.

A house pad takes its length times width times height in feet, divided by 27, in cubic yards of compacted fill. A 40 by 60 foot slab with 5 feet of pad around it, raised 12 inches, comes to about 130 cubic yards before allowing for compaction.

Questions answered on this page:
- Do you build house pads around Sherman and Denison? Yes. Hardrock Sand And Gravel builds house pads in Sherman, Denison and the rest of Grayson County. Call 903-420-0330 with the site address and the slab size, and have the pad spec close by if the builder or engineer has written one.
- Do you price pad fill by the ton or the cubic yard? Both. Hardrock Sand And Gravel prices pad fill and base by the ton and by the yard, and a full load is 20 yards or 20 tons. A built pad is always quoted after a site visit, because the elevation and the soil type change the fill and the work. Bring the cubic-yard figure from the pad math on this page to the first call.

## Pond Digging in Sherman, TX
URL: https://hardrock-sand-and-gravel.pageone.cloud/services/ponds/
Title: Pond Digging in Sherman, TX | Hardrock Sand And Gravel
Description: Pond digging and shaping for rural and residential land in Sherman, Denison and Grayson County, with rip rap for the banks. Call HARDROCK at 903-420-0330.

Hardrock Sand And Gravel digs and shapes ponds for rural and residential property in Sherman, Denison and across Grayson County. The same company can clear the spot first and haul rip rap for the banks afterward, so a landowner planning a stock pond or a pond near the house makes one call instead of three.

A new pond makes sense where runoff already collects: a low draw, the foot of a gentle slope, or a swale that stays wet after storms. Grayson County's Blackland Prairie clay helps a basin hold water, so the bigger question is usually where the water will come from and what the pond is for.

Pond size in cubic yards is length times width times average depth, all in feet, divided by 27. A basin 100 feet long, 60 feet wide and 6 feet deep on average holds about 1,333 cubic yards, which is roughly 269,000 gallons of water and the same volume of dirt to place.

Questions answered on this page:
- Does HARDROCK dig ponds outside Sherman? Hardrock Sand And Gravel takes pond work in Sherman, Denison and across Grayson County. Call 903-420-0330 with the property location and HARDROCK will confirm the job is in its area before anything is scheduled.
- How is a pond job priced? Hardrock Sand And Gravel always visits the site before quoting a pond, to check the elevation and the soil type, and then prices the digging along with any clearing or rip rap the site needs. Have a length, width and average depth in mind for the first call; the volume math on this page gives a starting number to share.

## Pea Gravel for Paths and Play Areas in Sherman, TX
URL: https://hardrock-sand-and-gravel.pageone.cloud/services/pea-gravel/
Title: Pea Gravel in Sherman, TX | Hardrock Sand And Gravel
Description: Small, rounded pea gravel for walkways, play areas, dog runs and drainage, delivered across Sherman, Denison and Grayson County. Call HARDROCK at 903-420-0330.

Hardrock Sand And Gravel delivers pea gravel to homes in Sherman, Denison and across Grayson County. The small, rounded stone suits garden walkways, backyard play areas, dog runs and drainage strips by downspouts, and it fits homeowners who want a surface that drains fast and rakes level in a few minutes.

Pea gravel works best on flat ground where people walk, kids play or rain needs a quick way out. Think garden paths, play areas, dog runs and the strip beside a foundation. Each stone is rounded, so the surface is easy on knees and paws, and water drops straight through it instead of sitting on top.

Pea gravel suits a loose surface that drains instantly and stays soft to walk and play on. Decomposed granite packs into a firmer floor that a wheelbarrow or stroller rolls across without sinking. River rock is bigger and heavier, so it covers beds and storm channels far better than it serves as somewhere to walk.

Questions answered on this page:
- Does HARDROCK deliver pea gravel to Sherman and nearby towns? Yes. Hardrock Sand And Gravel delivers pea gravel in Sherman, Denison and across Grayson County. Give the address and the size of the area when you call 903-420-0330, and the price and the delivery day get settled on that call.
- How much pea gravel do I need for a garden walkway? Multiply the walkway length by its width and by the depth, all in feet, then divide by 27 for cubic yards. A path 4 feet wide and 30 feet long at 3 inches deep works out to about 1.1 cubic yards. Round up slightly so low spots can be topped off later.
- How is pea gravel priced? Hardrock Sand And Gravel prices pea gravel by the ton and by the yard, and a full load is 20 yards or 20 tons. The delivered total depends on the amount and the drop-off address, so have your cubic-yard figure ready when you call 903-420-0330.

## Decomposed Granite in Sherman, TX
URL: https://hardrock-sand-and-gravel.pageone.cloud/services/decomposed-granite/
Title: Decomposed Granite in Sherman, TX | Hardrock Sand And Gravel
Description: Decomposed granite for firm garden paths, patios and xeriscape beds, delivered in Sherman, Denison and Grayson County, TX. Call HARDROCK at 903-420-0330.

Hardrock Sand And Gravel supplies and delivers decomposed granite and pink granite to homeowners and landscapers in Sherman, Denison and across Grayson County and the neighboring counties. DG is granite weathered down to small chips and fine grit, and once it is dampened and compacted it sets into a firm, earth-toned floor for garden paths, patios and xeriscape beds.

Decomposed granite makes a firmer path than pea gravel, because its blend of fine grit and small chips binds together once it is wetted and rolled. Pea gravel never binds; it stays loose and rolls. That difference makes DG easier going for wheelbarrows, strollers, patio chairs and anyone a little unsteady on their feet.

Decomposed granite holds up best on level ground with foot traffic but no standing water, such as garden paths, patios and xeriscape beds. Under shade trees and around fire pits it gives a clean, earth-toned floor, and in a hot Grayson County summer it shrinks the stretch of lawn that needs watering.

Questions answered on this page:
- Can HARDROCK deliver decomposed granite to my address? Hardrock Sand And Gravel delivers decomposed granite and pink granite in Sherman, Denison and throughout Grayson County, and into Collin, Denton, Fannin and Cooke counties. Delivery only; there is no pickup. Call 903-420-0330 with the delivery address and the square footage of the path or patio, and the cost and drop-off day are worked out during that conversation.
- Is decomposed granite sold per ton or per cubic yard? Both. Hardrock Sand And Gravel prices decomposed granite by the ton and by the yard, and a full load is 20 yards or 20 tons. The delivered total still moves with the quantity and the distance, so run the patio numbers above first, then ring 903-420-0330 for the current price.
- Will a decomposed granite path wash out in heavy rain? A well-built DG path with edging, a compacted base and a slight cross slope handles ordinary rain. Fast runoff crossing the path is what carries the fine grit away, so send gutter water and uphill drainage around it, and top-dress any thin spots after a big spring storm.

## Road Base for Drives and Pads in Sherman, TX
URL: https://hardrock-sand-and-gravel.pageone.cloud/services/road-base/
Title: Road Base in Sherman, TX | Hardrock Sand And Gravel
Description: Road base delivered to Sherman, Denison and Grayson County for gravel drives, house pads and parking areas on clay ground. Call HARDROCK at 903-420-0330.

Hardrock Sand And Gravel delivers road base to Sherman, Denison and the rest of Grayson County for homeowners, farms and builders who need a firm layer under a gravel drive, a house pad or a parking area. Compacted road base carries the weight, so the surface above it stops rutting when the clay gets wet.

A gravel drive without road base turns to mud because loose rock sits straight on Grayson County clay, and that clay goes soft when it soaks up water. Every wet spring the tires push the stone down into the mud, and by summer the same ground has shrunk and cracked.

Road base holds weight when it goes down in thin lifts, each one wetted and compacted before the next is spread. In Texas the same material is often called flex base: crushed stone mixed with fine particles that lock together under a roller or plate compactor into one dense layer.

Questions answered on this page:
- Can HARDROCK deliver road base to my property near Sherman? Hardrock Sand And Gravel hauls road base to addresses in Sherman, Denison and across Grayson County. Give the address and where on the lot the load should be dumped when you call 903-420-0330, and the delivery day is set on the same call.
- How many cubic yards of road base does a driveway take? Multiply the drive length by its width by the finished base depth, all in feet, then divide by 27. A 150-foot drive that is 12 feet wide with 6 inches of base works out to about 33 cubic yards before any allowance for compaction, which HARDROCK can help you add.
- How is a road base order priced? Hardrock Sand And Gravel prices road base by the ton and by the yard, and a full load is 20 yards or 20 tons. The delivered total turns on the amount and the haul to your address, so have your measurements ready and call 903-420-0330 to get the current figure.

## 57 and 67 Rock in Sherman, TX
URL: https://hardrock-sand-and-gravel.pageone.cloud/services/57-67-rock/
Title: 57 and 67 Rock Delivered in Sherman, TX | HARDROCK
Description: #57 and #67 crushed rock delivered in Sherman, Denison and Grayson County for French drains, driveway top course and concrete. Call HARDROCK at 903-420-0330.

Hardrock Sand And Gravel delivers #57 and #67 crushed rock to Sherman, Denison and Grayson County. Builders and homeowners pick 57 rock for French drains, culvert bedding and the top layer of a gravel drive, and the smaller 67 rock for concrete mixes, finer drainage beds and smoother walking surfaces.

Around Sherman, 57 and 67 crushed rock goes wherever water must pass through stone instead of pooling on clay. Typical spots are drain trenches, foundation drain backfill, pipe bedding and the finish layer of a drive. 67 rock is also a standard coarse aggregate in concrete.

57 rock runs from about 1 inch down to roughly 3/16 inch, while 67 rock runs from about 3/4 inch down to roughly 3/32 inch. The numbers come from the AASHTO M 43 size chart, which defines each grade by the sieves the stone passes through and stops on.

Questions answered on this page:
- Should I order 57 rock or 67 rock? Order 57 rock for French drains, culvert bedding and the finish layer on a gravel drive, where the larger stone keeps open gaps for water. Order 67 rock for a concrete mix, a finer drainage layer or anywhere a smoother, tighter surface matters. If the job could go either way, describe it to HARDROCK on the phone first.
- Does HARDROCK bring 57 and 67 rock out to Denison and the rest of the county? Yes. Hardrock Sand And Gravel delivers crushed rock to homes, farms and job sites in Sherman, Denison and the other Grayson County towns, and into Collin, Denton, Fannin and Cooke counties. Call 903-420-0330 with the address and the size you want, and HARDROCK will quote the load and set a delivery day by phone.
- What does a load of 57 or 67 rock cost? Hardrock Sand And Gravel prices 57 and 67 rock by the ton and by the yard, and a full load is 20 yards or 20 tons. The delivered figure depends on the size, the quantity and the distance to your site, so work out your cubic yards first, then call 903-420-0330 to hear the current price.

## Fill Dirt Delivered in Sherman, TX
URL: https://hardrock-sand-and-gravel.pageone.cloud/services/fill-dirt/
Title: Fill Dirt in Sherman, TX | Hardrock Sand And Gravel
Description: Fill dirt delivered for leveling, backfill and raising grade on homes, farms and building sites in Sherman and Grayson County. Call HARDROCK at 903-420-0330.

Hardrock Sand And Gravel delivers fill dirt to homes, farms and building sites in Sherman, Denison and across Grayson County. Fill dirt raises low spots, backfills trenches and walls, and builds up grade where water sits, and HARDROCK checks the quantity with you by phone before the load is scheduled.

Fill dirt fixes ground that sits too low or slopes the wrong way on a Sherman property. Typical jobs are puddles that last for days, soil sloping toward the house, trench and wall backfill, and areas raised for a shed or slab. On Grayson County clay, low spots rarely drain on their own.

A low spot needs length times width times depth in feet, divided by 27, plus extra for compaction. A 30-by-20-foot area raised 8 inches takes about 14.8 cubic yards before it is packed, so plan on roughly 16 to 18 cubic yards once the lifts are compacted.

Questions answered on this page:
- Do you deliver fill dirt to Sherman and nearby? Yes. Hardrock Sand And Gravel delivers fill dirt in Sherman, Denison and across Grayson County. Call 903-420-0330 with the address and the size of the area, and HARDROCK will confirm the delivery and a drop day.
- Is fill dirt the same thing as topsoil? No. Fill dirt is subsoil meant to be packed down to build height, while topsoil carries the organic matter grass needs. Build the height with fill dirt, then finish with a few inches of topsoil only where you want a lawn or garden bed.

## Mason Sand in Sherman, TX
URL: https://hardrock-sand-and-gravel.pageone.cloud/services/mason-sand/
Title: Mason Sand in Sherman, TX | Hardrock Sand And Gravel
Description: Mason sand delivered in Sherman, Denison and Grayson County, TX for mortar, flagstone and paver bedding, and sandboxes. Call HARDROCK at 903-420-0330.

Hardrock Sand And Gravel delivers mason sand to Sherman, Denison and Grayson County for masons, patio builders and homeowners. Mason sand is a fine, clean sand that mixes into smooth mortar for brick and stone, beds flagstone and pavers level, and fills a backyard sandbox with something soft enough for kids.

Mason sand is the right sand for finish work that needs a fine, even grain. That means mortar joints in brick and stone, a level bed under flagstone or light-duty pavers, and play sand in a sandbox. On structural concrete or under a driveway, a coarser material does the job better.

Mason sand fits mortar, sandboxes and bedding under flagstone because its grains are the finest and most even. Concrete sand is coarser and stronger in a concrete mix or under pavers that carry cars. Decomposed granite packs into a firm walking surface, and fill dirt only raises the grade.

Questions answered on this page:
- Which type of sand should I use for my project? Pick by grain size and job. Mason sand is the finest of the common bulk sands, which makes it the choice for mortar, setting flagstone and filling a sandbox. Concrete sand is coarser and is used in concrete mixes and under heavier paver work. Fill sand is for leveling and backfill. Tell HARDROCK what you are building and the call will sort out the right sand.
- Will HARDROCK haul mason sand to a home in Denison or out by the lake? Hardrock Sand And Gravel delivers mason sand to homes in Sherman, Denison and the rest of Grayson County. - Is mason sand priced per ton or per cubic yard? Both. Hardrock Sand And Gravel prices mason sand by the ton and by the yard, and a full load is 20 yards or 20 tons. The delivered price still moves with the amount and the trip to your address, so measure the patio, sandbox or mortar job first, then call 903-420-0330 for the current price.

## Rip Rap for Banks and Culverts in Sherman, TX
URL: https://hardrock-sand-and-gravel.pageone.cloud/services/rip-rap/
Title: Rip Rap Delivery in Sherman, TX | Hardrock Sand And Gravel
Description: Rip rap delivered and set over filter fabric on pond banks, creek slopes and culverts in Sherman, Denison and Grayson County. Call HARDROCK at 903-420-0330.

Hardrock Sand And Gravel delivers rip rap to Sherman, Denison and the rest of Grayson County and the neighboring counties, and arranges for it to be set on pond banks, creek slopes and culvert outlets. On a HARDROCK rip rap job, filter fabric goes down the bank first and the rock goes over it, so the clay underneath cannot wash out.

Rip rap stops erosion wherever moving water meets bare soil: pond banks hit by waves, creek bends, culvert outlets and ditches. Grayson County's heavy clay holds a shape when it is dry, but it slumps and washes away once water works at it, so an unprotected bank loses a little more ground with every storm.

On a HARDROCK rip rap job the rock goes over filter fabric. The bank is cleared, fabric is rolled down the slope, then a skid steer feeds rock to the bank and the stones are hand-set so they lock together. The fabric lets water drain out while holding the soil behind the rock in place.

Questions answered on this page:
- Do you deliver rip rap to Sherman and the surrounding area? Yes. Hardrock Sand And Gravel delivers rip rap across Sherman, Denison and the rest of Grayson County. Call 903-420-0330 with the address and the length of bank you need to cover, and HARDROCK will confirm the delivery, the price and a day.
- Do you sell rip rap by the ton or the cubic yard? Both. Hardrock Sand And Gravel prices rip rap by the ton and by the yard, and a full load is 20 yards or 20 tons. The delivered price still depends on the rock size, the amount and how far the load travels, so work out the cubic yards with the bank math above, then call 903-420-0330 for the current price.

## River Rock for Beds and Creeks in Sherman, TX
URL: https://hardrock-sand-and-gravel.pageone.cloud/services/river-rock/
Title: River Rock in Sherman, TX | Hardrock Sand And Gravel
Description: River rock for landscape beds, dry creek beds and downspout splash areas, delivered across Sherman, Denison and Grayson County. Call HARDROCK at 903-420-0330.

Hardrock Sand And Gravel delivers river rock to Sherman, Denison and the rest of Grayson County for landscape beds, dry creek beds and downspout splash areas. River rock is stone worn smooth by water and sold in size ranges, so the right pick depends on whether it will cover a bed or line a channel.

River rock does the most good where water lands or runs: under downspouts, along gutterless rooflines, in storm swales and across planting beds. Its weight keeps it in place when rain hits, so the bare clay underneath stays put instead of splashing onto siding or washing out into the lawn.

River rock size should match the job: small stone for bed cover, mid-size for channels and splash pads, and cobble for creek banks and edges. Suppliers sell river rock in size ranges rather than one exact size, so the ranges below are a guide to the conversation, not a stock list.

Questions answered on this page:
- Which size of river rock should I order? For bed cover and narrow channels, smaller river rock under about 1½ inches looks neat and fills the gaps. For downspout pads and the floor of a dry creek bed, 1 to 3 inch stone is the usual pick, with bigger cobble along the edges. Tell HARDROCK the job when you call and ask which sizes are available.
- Does HARDROCK bring river rock to Denison and other Grayson County towns? Hardrock Sand And Gravel delivers river rock in Sherman, Denison and the rest of Grayson County. - What is the difference between 57 rock and 67 rock? Both are clean crushed stone. 57 rock is the larger of the two and suits French drains, culvert bedding and the finish layer on a gravel drive. 67 rock is smaller and suits concrete mixes, finer drainage layers and places where a tighter surface matters. If a job could go either way, describe it to HARDROCK on the phone first.
- Which gravel is best for a driveway? A gravel driveway usually takes two layers: road base, which compacts into a firm lower layer, and 57 rock on top, which drains and gives tires grip. Soft ground may need fill dirt first. Tell Hardrock Sand And Gravel the length of the drive and what will drive on it and it will recommend the layers.
- What is the difference between pea gravel and decomposed granite? Pea gravel is small, rounded stone that stays loose, drains fast and needs edging to stay in place. Decomposed granite is fine crushed granite that packs firm underfoot, which suits paths, patios and xeriscape beds. Hardrock Sand And Gravel sells both, along with pink granite.
- Is fill dirt the same thing as topsoil? No. Fill dirt is subsoil meant to be packed down to build height, while topsoil carries the organic matter that grass needs. Build the height with fill dirt, then finish with a few inches of topsoil only where you want a lawn or garden bed.

- How many cubic yards do I need? Multiply length by width by depth in feet, then divide by 27. A 10 ft by 10 ft area covered 4 inches deep needs about 1.2 cubic yards. Add 5 to 10 percent for settling and spillage, and Hardrock Sand And Gravel can check your numbers before you order.
- How far does one cubic yard go? One cubic yard is 27 cubic feet. Spread 2 inches deep it covers about 162 square feet, 3 inches deep about 108 square feet and 4 inches deep about 81 square feet. Add 5 to 10 percent for settling.
- How do I order from Hardrock Sand And Gravel? Call 903-420-0330 or send the estimate form with the delivery address, the material and the size of the area in feet. Hardrock Sand And Gravel checks the quantity with you, gives the price and sets a delivery day by phone.
